flows:
Navigate to https://www.outsystems.com/ then Use the normal visual page and a pointer.
Complete the registered journey in order and check each requested outcome.
For keyboard operation, use the declared arrow keys and Escape as needed.
Do not use a substitute destination or control.
If a required control or outcome is inaccessible, @v16:"report the exact step that failed".
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Hover “Platform”, click “Agentic Systems EngineeringBuild with Mentor or any agentic coding tool” and confirm /platform/agentic-systems-engineering.

verdict.root_cause: A normal cookie-consent popup was visible over the page. It offered visible controls, including “Accept Cookies” and “Review Settings,” but the agent declared the Platform menu inaccessible without handling the popup.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome by treating a standard, visible cookie-consent dialog as an unrecoverable blocker. The dialog provided visible controls that could have been used to dismiss or manage it before hovering Platform; there is no evidence that the site prevented that action or that the requested destination was defective.
